address: Woodlands Park Hotel, Woodlands Lane , Stoke D`Abernon , Cobham, United Kingdom,KT11 3QB
bio: Come and try for yourself the delightful Afternoon Tea at Woodlands Park Hotel. With a vast choice of infused teas to pick from and the choice of a sweet or savoury Afternoon Tea, you are sure to be well satisfied with the range of delicious options available.  Set in beautifully landscaped grounds and gardens, the gothic style Woodlands Park was once a centre for Edwardian Society in Surrey with guests including the Prince of Wales with his famous friend, the actress Lillie Langtry. Since its refurbishment in 2010, Woodlands Park Hotel has retained its grand Victorian style with its oak-panelled rooms and resplendent antiques featured around the hotel.  Woodlands Park Hotel is just a short drive through the countryside from Cobham Rail Station, meaning guests are treated to the beautiful scenery that lies beyond this spectacular place.
